Overview

Brasília is a city in DF with a population of 3,055,149. Brazil’s modernist capital, a UNESCO World Heritage city designed by Oscar Niemeyer, with the highest quality of life in the country. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
